learningObjective: Realize that stacked ring-rectangles form a triangle with base 2πR and height R, whose area equals πR² — the circle area formula
ahaMoment: The moment the sweep completes and the student sees that the stacked bars form a perfect triangle with base 2πR and height R — and that the triangle area formula gives exactly πR², revealing where the circle area formula comes from

miniSpec.title: Adding Ring Areas with Accumulator
miniSpec.manipulated_variable: A slider or draggable handle that controls how far through the radius the sweep has progressed (from 0 to R), adding ring areas one by one
miniSpec.primary_visual_feedback: As the student drags the slider outward, horizontal bars appear and stack upward, each bar's width proportional to 2πr for that ring's radius. The bars form a triangle shape. A running area counter displays the accumulated sum, approaching πR² as the sweep completes. The formula 2πr × dr is shown above the currently-adding ring.
miniSpec.goal_structure: Guided sweep from 0 to full radius R, with the payoff being the completed triangle and the area equaling πR²
miniSpec.causal_chain_exposed: Current sweep position r, the ring being added with its area formula 2πr × dr displayed, the running total of accumulated area, the triangle dimensions labeled (base = 2πR when complete, height = R), and the final area calculation ½ × 2πR × R = πR²
miniSpec.trace_strategy: All added bars remain visible, building up the triangle progressively; this accumulation IS the concept
miniSpec.aha_moment: The moment the sweep completes and the student sees that the stacked bars form a perfect triangle with base 2πR and height R — and that the triangle area formula gives exactly πR², revealing where the circle area formula comes from

modelVariables.R: The circle radius (frozen, carried over from previous section)
modelVariables.numRings: Number of concentric rings (frozen, carried over from previous section)
modelVariables.sweepR: Current sweep position (0 to R), student-dragged
modelVariables.triangleEmerges_accumulatedArea: derived: sum of ring areas up to sweepR
modelVariables.triangleEmerges_currentRingArea: derived: area of the ring at current sweepR (2πr × dr)
modelVariables.triangleEmerges_triangleArea: derived: ½ × 2πR × R = πR² (the final formula result)

assertions.description: On load, the sweep starts at a low value so the triangle is incomplete, inviting the student to drag further
assertions.visualCheck: Triangle is partially formed with bars stacked, not yet complete

assertions.description: As sweep increases, more bars appear and accumulated area grows
assertions.visualCheck: More horizontal bars visible, triangle shape emerging, area counter increased

assertions.description: At full radius, the triangle is complete and area equals πR²
assertions.visualCheck: Complete triangle visible with base 2πR and height R labeled, area shows πR² ≈ 50.27

assertions.description: R and numRings are frozen and do not change during interaction
assertions.visualCheck: The circle radius R and number of rings remain constant

invariants.description: Accumulated area is always between 0 and πR²
Sweep position stays within 0 to R
